name: Automated Agents
audience_feeling: The reader should feel oriented, respected, and able to choose a safe next question without being pushed into an external action.
promise: Turn one career or positioning question into bounded research, visible uncertainty, and an explicit next proposal.

preferred_terms.bounded research: focused collection with explicit budgets and stop conditions
preferred_terms.proposal: a recommendation awaiting review or approval
preferred_terms.owner: the person who decides identity, profile, and external actions
preferred_terms.private FOSSIL: the intended private store for personal evidence and proposals

good_examples: Ask one focused question, preserve what was observed, and label what remains unknown.
A saved proposal records an idea; it does not make the idea true or approved.
bad_examples: The agent knows your perfect career path.
Run the autonomous recruiter and let it contact the right people.
